topics.name: qdecr
topics.title: Run vertex-wise analyses
topics.description: Runs vertex-wise analyses using a variety of statistical models
topics.usage:
qdecr(
  id,
  data,
  vertex = "qdecr",
  margs = NULL,
  model = c("stats::lm", "QDECR::megha", "RcppEigen::fastLm", "stats::glm",
    "survival::coxph", "default"),
  target = "fsaverage",
  hemi = c("lh", "rh"),
  measure = c("thickness", "area", "area.pial", "curv", "jacobian_white", "pial",
    "pial_lgi", "sulc", "volume", "w_g.pct", "white.H", "white.K"),
  fwhm = ifelse(measure == "pial_lgi", 5, 10),
  mcz_thr = 0.001,
  cwp_thr = 0.025,
  mgh = NULL,
  mask = NULL,
  mask_path = system.file("extdata", paste0(hemi, ".fsaverage.cortex.mask.mgh"),
    package = "QDECR"),
  project,
  dir_subj = Sys.getenv("SUBJECTS_DIR"),
  dir_fshome = Sys.getenv("FREESURFER_HOME"),
  dir_tmp = dir_out,
  dir_out,
  dir_out_tree = TRUE,
  file_out_tree = !dir_out_tree,
  clean_up = TRUE,
  clean_up_bm = TRUE,
  clobber = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE,
  debug = FALSE,
  n_cores = 1,
  prep_fun = "prep_fastlm",
  analysis_fun = "analysis_chunkedlm",
  chunk_size = 1000
)

arguments.name: id
arguments.html: the name of the id variable that matches the dataset to the Freesurfer output

arguments.name: data
arguments.html: a required argument that contains a data frame, a list of data frames or an imputed object that is supported by the imp2list function (mice, mi, etc.).

arguments.name: vertex
arguments.html: the preposition to the vertex measure (default: "qdecr_")

arguments.name: margs
arguments.html: the arguments that should be provided to the function of interest (e.g. stats::lm)

arguments.name: model
arguments.html: the function to grab the arguments from (this will be removed in a later version)

arguments.name: target
arguments.html: the target template (default = "fsaverage")

arguments.name: hemi
arguments.html: hemisphere to analyze ("lh" or "rh")

arguments.name: measure
arguments.html: the vertex-wise measure to use ("thickness", "area", etc.)

arguments.name: fwhm
arguments.html: full width half max (default = 10 mm, for pial_lgi it is 5 mm)

arguments.name: mcz_thr
arguments.html: A numeric value for the Monte Carlo simulation threshold (default: 0.001). Any of the following are accepted (equivalent values separate by /): 13/1.3/0.05, 20/2.0/0.01, 23/2.3/0.005, 30/3.0/0.001, 33/3.3/0.0005, 40/4.0/0.0001.

arguments.name: cwp_thr
arguments.html: the cluster-wise p-value threshold on top of all correction (default = 0.025, as there are 2 hemispheres)

arguments.name: mgh
arguments.html: NOT IMPLEMENTED; path to existing merged mgh file, default is NULL

arguments.name: mask
arguments.html: mgh file to mask analysis; default is to use the cortex label from the target

arguments.name: mask_path
arguments.html: path to the mask; default is the cortex mask that is provided with the QDECR package

arguments.name: project
arguments.html: the base name you want to assign to the output files

arguments.name: dir_subj
arguments.html: directory contain the surface-based maps (mgh files); defaults to SUBJECTS_DIR

arguments.name: dir_fshome
arguments.html: Freesurfer directory; defaults to FREESURFER_HOME

arguments.name: dir_tmp
arguments.html: directory to store the temporary big matrices; useful for shared memory; defaults to dir_out

arguments.name: dir_out
arguments.html: the directory where to save the data to (defaults to the current directory)

arguments.name: dir_out_tree
arguments.html: if TRUE, creates a dir_out/project directory. If FALSE, all output is placed directory into dir_out

arguments.name: file_out_tree
arguments.html: if TRUE, adds the full project name to the output file names. By default it is the inverse of dir_out_tree

arguments.name: clean_up
arguments.html: NOT IMPLEMENTED; will be used for setting cleaning of other files

arguments.name: clean_up_bm
arguments.html: if TRUE, cleans all big matrices (.bk) that were generated in dir_tmp

arguments.name: clobber
arguments.html: if TRUE, ignores already existing directories and writes over them; if FALSE, stops and warns user that a given directory already exists

arguments.name: verbose
arguments.html: if TRUE, writes out standard log; if FALSE, no output is generated

arguments.name: debug
arguments.html: NOT IMPLEMENTED; will output the maximal log to allow for easy debugging

arguments.name: n_cores
arguments.html: the number of cores to be used

arguments.name: prep_fun
arguments.html: Name of the function that needs to be called for the preparation step (do not touch unless you know what you are doing!)

arguments.name: analysis_fun
arguments.html: Name of the function that needs to be called for the analysis step (do not touch unless you know what you are doing!)

arguments.name: chunk_size
arguments.html: Integer; the desired chunk size for the chunked lm

topics.details: This function is the worker function of the QDECR package. It allows .mgh format data as input and allows statistical analyses per vertex. A variety of statistical models have been implemented, such as linear regression.
